History requires the exact anchored tape tail, header and per-member receipts; unanchored legacy warmup and legacy bare source-kind high-water are rejected.

Nonempty bounded restart gaps require a complete configured new-live finite window; gapless valid history remains reusable subject to core freshness and continuity. Missing slots are never fabricated.

Domain-tagged source namespace uses only the sorted full exchange/current-trading-day map. Same-day route/grid changes retain high-water checks; logical-run risk identity, budgets and loss baseline are unchanged.
Sticky continuity failures and final nonempty-tape high-water mismatch fail after cleanup; independently qualified owned CANCEL/CLOSE remain available.
Normalize string enum readiness to a built-in string; initialize saved history before guarded loading and derive cutover after source readiness.
